title: Claude background command running keys persist across turns after their terminal notice
outcome: A Claude background command's running key no longer outlives its terminal task notification, so later checks in its worktree are not marked overlapped by finished work.
acceptance: At an ordinary turn begin, running command keys whose owning turn has ended are cleared, mirroring master's clear at grant begin (5dd913d2 engram_host_adapter.rs:8053-8057), while a background command still running in the current turn keeps its key
A focused test shows a background key from an ended turn does not taint the next turn's checks, and a still-running background command of the current turn still marks overlap
claude_outstanding_work::a_background_launch_acknowledgement_retires_nothing_and_its_terminal_notice_does is consistent with the new rule (adjusted only if it asserted the defect)
No gate or grant semantics are revived

completion.summary: A turn's start clears running command keys from ended turns, while a command launched in the current turn keeps its key. Landed in 87f49ed0.
